name: Long-read overlap detection evaluation
description: A systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art algorithms for detecting overlaps in long sequencing reads, surveying innovations and challenges.
reputation: Well-regarded within the genomics/bioinformatics community as a systematic comparison of long-read overlap detection methods.
notes: Caveats include sensitivity to sequencing error profiles and contamination, dataset biases and coverage variation, potential saturation on small or synthetic datasets, and the fact that this is a non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark focused on algorithmic performance rather than language-model evaluation.
